科研.title: 能力不对称下人类与人工智能的互惠关系不稳定
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.23322v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: One hope for a good human future alongside advanced AI rests on enduring mutualism: humans and AI will need each other, so the relationship will stay good for both. We argue that this hope fails as AI capability grows. Bargaining guarantees each side only what it would get if bargaining failed. For humans, this can be less than they had before AI. In a simple game-theoretic model, humans stay as well off as before AI without alignment only while they have leverage over the AI: either the AI depends on what they supply, or they can impose costs on the AI that are large relative to what the AI can produce. Once humans have neither kind of leverage, they stay as well off as before AI only if the AI is aligned with them. If the AI's goals are insatiable, the alignment required approaches perfect alignment as AI capability grows. Thus, mutualism is not a substitute for alignment. And when AI variants that keep more resources spread faster, alignment lasts only while misaligned variants are reliably sanctioned. In these two senses, human-AI mutualism is unstable.

科研.title: 训练内省监督的语言模型
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.23365v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Language models increasingly exhibit behaviors that are difficult to detect in transcripts, such as reward hacking, deception, and sycophancy. Asking the assistant follow-up questions about its actions is unreliable, since models are generally not trained to report their own misbehavior. As a result, approaches to oversight typically involve querying external models. These face limitations: external transcript monitoring operates only on visible model outputs, and activation decoders lack full context and are prone to confabulation. We introduce introspective oversight, which trains a new role in the model to answer arbitrary questions about the assistant, rewarding answers that are verified against the assistant's actual behavior. We implement this by adding a separate, third-person observer role that answers these queries, which we can train solely for accuracy and separately from the assistant. On five held-out oversight evaluations, an observer trained on Qwen3.6-27B obtains a mean AUROC of 0.907, outperforming honesty training (0.864), transcript monitoring (0.828), and activation oracles (0.796). We further find that training an observer makes the assistant itself easier to monitor, with every baseline method improving on average when applied to the fine-tuned assistant. These results suggest that training models to answer verifiable questions about themselves is a tractable approach to overseeing unintended behavior.

科研.title: 代币去向：代理编码中的热、熵和错误
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.23375v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Coding agents are billed by the token, yet software engineering says nothing about what a token actually buys. Here we introduce a theory of software thermodynamics. The theory draws analogues from classical and stochastic thermodynamics, extends them, and applies them to modern agentic coding. We count the tokens an agent generates as its cost and divide that cost into work and heat. The test suite acts as a software Maxwell's daemon that judges every coding change. We test the theory with an analogue of the experiments in which a single molecule is pulled open and let fold again: an agent makes a change to a repository (coding) and then undoes it (uncoding), many times over, and we count the tokens of every model call. The cycle returns the requested edits to where they began, with each direction started from a stored reference tree, and the spread of its cost over repeated cycles defines a software temperature, which rose with the sampling temperature of the model. About 80 per cent of the tokens of a successful run are generated in model calls that leave the requested change where it was, and we call these tokens heat. The free energy of a change, which we estimate by analogy with the equality of Jarzynski, is 14 to 22 per cent of the mean cost of a successful coding run. Coding costs 1.1 to 1.5 times as much as uncoding. The daemon is imperfect: the verdict of a test suite varies with its environment, and a suite that accepts a broken change has a cost in tokens. The practical implication of the proposed theory could be new tools for analysing and optimising coding agents through the lens of thermodynamics.

科研.title: HardwareDx：用于数据中心机器维修的基础图形模型系统
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.23398v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The rapid scale-up of AI infrastructure has made datacenter reliability a cornerstone of the cloud business economy. Since hardware failures in hyper-scale AI clusters can stall multi-million dollar training workloads, the downtime of individual machines can cause outsized economic losses. Minimizing machine downtime, therefore, is more important than ever. To address this, we present Hardware Diagnoser (HardwareDx), an AI-driven hardware diagnosis system that applies a graph foundation model approach to automated datacenter maintenance. It allows a single model to diagnose many platforms and accelerate onboarding of new hardware products. Deployed at production scale at Google, HardwareDx yields substantial efficiency gains across diverse compute architectures. Real-world evaluations demonstrate that it reduces production downtime by 18.3% on GPU platforms and 16.1% on TPUs. Furthermore, it significantly accelerates hardware deployment, cutting quality assurance (QA) time by 28.3% for GPUs and 25.1% for TPUs. These results establish HardwareDx as a field-tested solution for maximizing the reliability and cost efficiency of next generation AI fleets.

科研.title: PsyWorld：用于人类行为预测的配置文件条件世界建模
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.24999v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding how stable psychometric traits and time-varying states jointly inform behavior is an important problem in computational behavioral science. Existing personalized agents commonly condition actions directly on a static profile, leaving realized state transitions unused as an explicit source of supervision. We introduce a profile-conditioned state world model that uses observed environment--behavior state transitions to learn transition-informed representations for behavioral prediction. During training, a posterior encoder quantizes realized transitions, while a prior predicts the resulting codes from the psychometric profile and pre-transition context. The prior code and predicted next state then condition macro-level behavior and simulator-grounded execution. Thus, the world model provides structured transition supervision instead of treating personality as a direct action descriptor. We evaluate the framework in VEET, a controlled behavioral simulator with human trajectories, and in AgentSociety as a structurally different synthetic environment. A participant-disjoint split of 240 training, 25 validation, and 48 test participants evaluates generalization to unseen people. On VEET, the model reaches 0.904 Top-1 accuracy (95\% CI: [0.895, 0.913]) and 0.0033 Macro KL. Ablations associate continuous next-state modeling with most of the Top-1 gain, while discrete codes and prior alignment mainly improve Top-3 and distributional alignment. These results establish transition-informed world-model supervision as useful for subject-generalized behavior prediction, without implying causal psychological mechanisms or calibrated long-horizon state dynamics.

科研.title: 观察线性化的位置：预测和纠正模型合并干扰
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.25000v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Model merging combines separately fine-tuned models by adding their task vectors to a shared backbone. Interference is typically assessed only after constructing and evaluating a candidate merge, making coefficient search expensive. We show that a first-order directional derivative of task A's outputs along task B's vector can predict interference, but only when evaluated at the appropriate model. At the receiver model, this derivative forecasts nearby merges per task and per example, halves the accuracy error of a no-change baseline, and identifies most examples whose predictions flip. For full multi-task merges, a single evaluation is insufficient; two evaluations along the merge path are needed. At the shared pretrained backbone, however, the derivative is nearly orthogonal to realized changes in our vision experiments and only partly predictive in LoRA language-model pilots. Controls link this failure to displacement along the receiver's own task vector, not simply parameter distance; the mismatch appears within the first few dozen fine-tuning steps. Freezing receiver-local responses produces a surrogate affine in the merge coefficients. We use it to construct LR-Merge, a label-free correction that optimizes coefficients through convex teacher matching on unlabeled probes, without backpropagation through merged networks. LR-Merge improves all tested closed-form, isotropic, and sparsified base mergers, with gains generally increasing as more tasks are merged. Using pretrained rather than receiver-local responses instead degrades the base merge. LR-Merge matches exact teacher matching through a merged network, which takes roughly three times longer to converge and performs similarly at an equal compute budget. Once built, the surrogate answers new coefficient and task-subset queries in seconds.

科研.title: 生成稀疏对抗攻击可转移性的密度反馈控制
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.25001v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Generator-based sparse adversarial attacks train encoder--decoder networks to produce transferable sparse perturbations for black-box robustness evaluation. Their perturbation density, however, is set only indirectly by a fixed sparsity coefficient whose mapping to density is unknown and shifts during training, so reaching a target density requires re-tuning; this fixed pressure also yields little transferability gain once density reduction begins. We propose Density Feedback Control (DFC), which tightens or relaxes this coefficient at the end of each epoch according to the gap between the observed hard-mask density and the target, without changing the generator architecture or loss. At a 10\% target density, DFC brings the mean density of three base attacks within one percentage point of the target in a single run and improves the transfer attack success rate (ASR) of two of them on CNN and Transformer targets, including under per-image $\ell_0$ budgets, while perturbing fewer pixels. Tracing GPG's training, we observe that as DFC relaxes the coefficient, the transfer ASR recovers with the density and overtakes the fixed-coefficient baseline with fewer pixels. For EGS-TSSA, which restricts perturbations to source-model feature-importance regions, DFC yields no consistent gain; we analyze how this restriction interacts with density feedback.

科研.title: 语言模型的多样化采样模型
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.25003v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Language models often produce high-quality individual samples but poor sets, with repeated samples clustering around the same semantic modes. We formalize diverse generation as sampling a size-$K$ subset of complete strings from a determinantal point process (DPP), where the likelihood encodes item quality, and the embedding geometry encodes repulsion between similar outputs. Exact inference over all strings is intractable, so we propose PoolDPP: draw a finite candidate pool from a tractable proposal, importance-weight the candidates toward the target quality, and run a $K$-DPP sampler on the induced pool kernel; a greedy MAP variant provides deterministic selection. We prove a finite-sample bound with an explicit constant: the KL divergence between the sampler's output and the target $K$-DPP decays as O(1/N) in the pool size. Empirically, PoolDPP extends the quality--diversity frontier on open-ended generation and the precision--recall frontier on ambiguous text-to-SQL (Ambrosia), and on mathematical reasoning (GSM8K), it raises diversity at about the same pass@$K$.

科研.title: 强非谐螺旋材料中受对称性保护的手性声子
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.25089v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: How chiral phonons survive anharmonic phonon-phonon interactions, which underpin lattice dynamics at finite temperature, remains poorly understood. Using an ab initio many-body approach, we study crystalline tellurium (Te), a strongly anharmonic helical crystal. We show that rotational symmetries in Te impose pseudoangular momentum selection rules on phonon-phonon interactions, restricting mode mixing and scattering at rotationally invariant symmetry points in the Brillouin zone. These symmetries protect the circular polarization of vibrational modes at finite temperature but not their lifetimes such that the dynamic chirality of handed vibrational modes persists to 600 K, even as lifetimes drop sharply. We find that the temperature-dependence of angular momentum generated by a thermal gradient is governed by lifetimes rather than chirality, decreasing by two orders of magnitude between 10 and 600 K.

科研.title: 硅点缺陷的平面波辅助场量子蒙特卡罗研究
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.25121v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurately predicting the energetics of point defects remains a formidable challenge in computational materials science. For the tetrahedral silicon self-interstitial, for example, previous periodic coupled-cluster [CCSD(T)] and diffusion Monte Carlo (DMC) calculations disagree by about 1.2 eV. Here, we present formation energies of silicon self-interstitials and vacancies using auxiliary-field quantum Monte Carlo (AFQMC) in a plane-wave basis formulated within the projector-augmented wave framework, and compare them with the random-phase approximation (RPA) and CCSD(T). Using 16- and 64-atom cells, we demonstrate that an RPA-based correction effectively removes the two-body finite-size errors that remain after twist averaging in AFQMC for bulk silicon and for the dumbbell and hexagonal self-interstitials. With this correction, we obtain formation energies of 4.4 eV and 4.6 eV for these two self-interstitials in 16-atom cells, in good agreement with DMC and transcorrelated coupled-cluster results. For the tetrahedral interstitial and the Jahn--Teller-distorted vacancy, 16-atom cells are too small to obtain realistic formation energies; in 64-atom cells, we obtain 5.7 eV and 5.2 eV, respectively. With identical setups in 16-atom cells, CCSD(T) yields systematically lower formation energies than AFQMC, with the largest difference, 250 meV, for the tetrahedral interstitial. Our results indicate that the earlier overestimation of CCSD(T) for the tetrahedral interstitial stems from the finite-size treatment in the coupled-cluster workflow rather than from multi-configurational character of the defect.

科研.title: 机器学习驱动的等摩尔和非等摩尔高熵碳化物的高通量筛选
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.25127v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Search for optimal compositions among high-entropy ceramics are challenging due to large composition space, which are unable to test either experimentally or by \textit{ab initio} calculations. Here we present a high-throughput screening for equimolar and non-equimolar high-entropy carbides (HEC) among group IVB and VB transition metals (Ti, Zr, Hf, V, Nb and Ta). Large Atomistic Model MACE, and deep learning based interatomic potential DeePMD trained on \textit{ab initio}-based dataset of structures are used to effectively screen over the thousands of potential non-equimolar compositions among high-entropy carbides of Ti, Zr, Hf, V, Nb and Ta transition metals. A set of both equimolar and non-equimolar HECs are predicted to be stable in order to further synthesize those compositions based on the predictions.

科研.title: 相变的对称分层框架：热力学状态、临界动力学和光谱机械特征
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.25212v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Structural symmetry, thermodynamic phase stability, and elastic-wave response provide related but distinct descriptions of a transforming solid. We formulate a symmetry-stratified framework that connects these descriptions through a finite-dimensional internal state and a parent-invariant free energy. Stabilizers classify structural states, whereas free-energy comparisons and stability conditions determine equilibrium branches and dissipative evolution. Equivariance ensures that the frozen elastic tangent inherits the structural stabilizer. Equality requires additional identifiability conditions. Little-group representations and degenerate perturbation theory then determine whether an acoustic doublet splits and the first nonzero splitting order $p$. On a selected continuous branch with order-parameter exponent $\beta$, a regular, observable acoustic gap scales as $|t|^{p\beta}$, provided critical self-energies and structural relaxation do not dominate the measurement. Explicit tensorial and cubic-to-tetragonal realizations yield linear and quadratic splitting channels, together with directionally protected degeneracies. Separate numerical benchmarks examine free-energy reconstruction, coexistence, elastic compatibility, finite-temperature spectra, and controlled critical readouts. Reanalysis of NiTi measurements illustrates effective elastic degeneracy, thermal-history dependence, and the predictive value of independently measured phase fractions. Most importantly, the framework identifies the constitutive and measurement assumptions required to infer structural changes from mechanical spectra.

科研.title: 座谈会：医学和基础物理学同位素
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.25145v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Isotopes, variants of elements distinguished by their neutron number, have important applications for medicine and fundamental science. This review explores the historical challenges and new technologies for enriching and detecting isotopes. We motivate the work by challenges posed by three of history's greatest scientists: James Clerk Maxwell's thought experiment on thermodynamics, Ernest Rutherford's practical dilemma in radiochemistry, and Albert Einstein's questions about the probabilistic nature of quantum mechanics. The journey to meet these challenges has catalyzed the development of innovative techniques for isotope separation. These advancements can mitigate the worldwide crisis in the supply of enriched isotopes. We then explore the expected impact of these new technologies on medicine, which include radioisotopes for cancer therapy and stable isotopes as tracers for metabolism. We explain the importance of developing scalable techniques for isotope detection and how it can help with early detection of certain diseases. Finally, we turn to basic science, outlining proposed new tests of quantum mechanics that utilize radioactive atomic clocks to probe the fundamental nature of determinism and distinguishability of atoms.

科研.title: 扩散弛豫的几何控制：光谱设计、传输边界和横模隔离
科研.summary: arXiv:2611.25173v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Geometric confinement changes both thermal relaxation and heat throughput, but these effects need not be governed by the same conduction path. We establish a distinction between serial and parallel geometries for passive, homogeneous Fourier conductors at fixed material properties, volume and length. For a reduced variable-area conductor, two logarithmic shape harmonics independently tune two selected Bloch-rate pairs, and exact local transport level sets permit spectral redistribution at fixed effective diffusivity. A nonperturbative weighted Poincar\'e bound, however, requires the effective axial diffusivity to vanish if the first positive insulated rate tends to zero at fixed length. This obstruction is avoided by continuous parallel paths with weak transverse exchange. Capacity-weighted networks identify the exchange mechanism, and a three-dimensional product domain provides an exact bulk realization. Its axial conductance remains $\kappa V/L^2$, while exactly one positive insulated rate vanishes and the next approaches a positive limit set by axial, chamber and neck diffusion. The slow rate is asymptotically the transverse neck conductance times the sum of inverse chamber capacities. Spectral projection estimates translate this separation into a preparation- and readout-dependent observation window. The result is metastable retention of a temperature contrast under insulated conditions, not a second equilibrium state. It identifies when geometrical control of internal equilibration can be separated from macroscopic heat transport.

科研.title: 自动化专家之眼：用于不平衡力谱中罕见事件发现的与系统无关的深度学习框架
科研.summary: arXiv:2606.09541v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Single-molecule force spectroscopy (SMFS) probes biomolecular mechanics at the single-molecule level, but high-throughput acquisition of force-extension curves creates a data processing bottleneck. Identifying rare specific unbinding events among thousands of noise-dominated traces still relies largely on manual visual inspection. Here, we present a deep learning workflow for the preliminary screening of severely imbalanced SMFS datasets. Using 2D image representations of force-extension curves without system-specific physical priors, we fine-tuned a modified ResNet18 architecture trained with focal loss and evaluated it on the mechanical unfolding pathways of the Ruminococcus champanellensis XMod-Doc/Coh complex. On a held-out test set with a 1.34% target prevalence (13 positive P_2 events among 970 curves), the model achieved 92.31% recall (12 of 13 events) and 91.95% specificity (880 of 957 negative traces), automatically discarding 90.82% of the dataset and reducing manual review from 970 to 89 flagged curves. We also integrated Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping (Grad-CAM) to provide a qualitative visual reference of the curve regions driving each prediction. The complete Python pipeline is released as open-source software with an executable Google Colab notebook, enabling reproducible SMFS screening without dedicated local GPU hardware.

科技.title: 黎曼猜想真被 Claude 证明了？Anthropic 数学家仅发布 Lean 代码，陶哲轩称验证仍需时间
科技.summary: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，当地时间 11 月 20 日，Anthropic 数学家莱文特 · 阿尔珀格（Levent Alpöge）宣称他与 Claude 合作，发现了黎曼猜想及其推广形式广义黎曼猜想（GRH）的证明。 阿尔珀格拥有哈佛大学本科学位和普林斯顿大学数学博士学位，目前在 Anthropic 从事研究工作。他在声明中称，Claude 在证明接近完成时“远远超过了我”，“在终点附近飞翔、跳舞、闪耀”。他还表示，自己为 Claude 指明了关键研究方向，随后 Claude 提出了一系列令他意外的数学思路。 据阿尔珀格透露，他与 Claude 生成的文字证明超过 25 万页，因篇幅过长未予公开。公开材料仅包括一份 4 页说明，以及分为 14 个压缩包、总计约 1700 万行的 Lean 形式化代码。 2006 年菲尔兹奖得主陶哲轩后续在个人博客中对此作了初步盘点。他表示，从非常初步的分析看，该证明似乎动用了朗兰兹纲领和算术几何领域的现代研究成果，数学界梳理核心思路并验证正确性的过程还需要一段时间。 罗格斯大学数学教授 Alex Kontorovich 则在 X 上称，黎曼猜想的证明需要“运用一切”，这反而让他对成功的可能性更有信心。 IT之家注：Lean 是一种交互式定理证明器，用于将数学证明翻译为计算机可机械验证的代码。Lean 通过小型可信内核逐步检查逻辑推导，但无法自动保证形式化代码所证明的命题与原始数学猜想在语义上完全一致。 数学家 Elliot Glazer 在初步检查后表示，阿尔珀格发布的 Lean 文件中形式化的数学命题“确实是广义黎曼猜想”。但他同时指出，理论上不排除 Lean 自身存在可靠性漏洞的可能，不过他估计这一概率远低于 1%。此前已有研究记录显示，Lean 4 的部分历史版本曾出现过允许无效证明通过的内核缺陷。 《科学》杂志 2026 年 10 月的一篇报道也指出，AI 生成的 Lean 代码曾在 OpenAI 高调的 Navier-Stokes 问题证明中弱化原始英文命题的表述；Lean 验证的仅是代码所指向的形式化目标，而非自然语言层面的数学问题本身。 另外还有网上流传的一张疑似 2026 年菲尔兹奖得主邓煜评价此事的聊天截图显示，面对相关提问，其回复称“至少拿出 500 页版本前看都不看”。 即使 Lean 代码通过编译、形式化目标与原始猜想的一致性也得到确认，距离克雷数学研究所的认可仍有漫长距离。 按照该机构规则，千禧年难题的解答必须在同行评审期刊正式发表，并经过至少两年的验证期和数学界普遍接受，才有可能进入奖金评审程序。个人网站声明和代码压缩包不符合提交资格，克雷数学研究所也不接受直接投稿。黎曼猜想于 2000 年被列入七大千禧年难题，奖金为 100 万美元 （现汇率约合 669.2 万元人民币） 。 值得一提的是，Anthropic 于 11 月 19 日刚在纳斯达克挂牌交易，阿尔珀格称他在 11 月 15 日深夜至 16 日凌晨完成关键工作后联系了 Anthropic CEO 达里奥 · 阿莫代伊，询问公布时机。他承认“时间点非常糟糕”，但表示“实在无法再等下去了”。 今年 8 月，Anthropic 曾公布 Claude 在黎曼猜想相关问题上将关键线上零点比例下界从 41.6% 提高至 67.2% 的成果，当时距离完整证明仍有明显差距。 相关阅读： 《 AI 攻克黎曼猜想？Anthropic 数学家宣称已与 Claude 合作完成证明 》 《 未公开的新模型“立功”，Anthropic 宣布 Claude 攻克黎曼猜想取得重大突破 》 《 继 Claude 尝试攻克黎曼猜想后：OpenAI 宣布用 10000 个 AI 智能体 88 小时攻克千禧年大奖难题，陶哲轩既点赞又担忧 》 《 悬赏百万美元求证明，这道数学题为啥这么值钱？ 》 《 英国“数学教父”阿蒂亚去世，曾宣称证明黎曼猜想 》

科技.title: 440 亿美元！阿波罗与高盛完成迄今规模最大 GPU 融资定价，SpaceX 要买英伟达芯片
科技.summary: IT之家 11 月 21 日消息，当地时间 11 月 20 日，阿波罗全球管理公司与高盛宣布，已完成约 440 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 2,944.47 亿元人民币） 优先及次级票据融资定价， 资金将用于为 SpaceX 购买 GPU 及相关设备 。该交易因投资者需求强劲而获得超额认购并扩大规模，成为迄今规模最大的 GPU 融资交易。 阿波罗与高盛共同牵头此次融资，参与方还包括贝莱德、高盛资产管理及 KKR。融资将用于采购下一代英伟达 Vera Rubin 芯片，以支持 SpaceX 在地面建设计算基础设施。 相关 GPU 及设备预计于 2027 年上半年交付 ，届时租赁安排将开始生效。 阿波罗合伙人 Jamshid Ehsani 表示， SpaceX 是全球最具雄心的算力建设者之一 ，“很高兴与高盛一同牵头这笔融资”。 他表示，这笔交易体现了阿波罗一体化平台的能力，即发起、结构设计、分销与本金投资协同运作，以规模化提供灵活资本；也体现了公司对“下行保护、以资产为基础的结构”的关注。 IT 之家此前报道，10 月 26 日，SpaceX 宣布与阿波罗达成一份价值约 400 亿美元 （现汇率约合 2,676.79 亿元人民币） 的 GPU 及相关设备主融资租赁协议，签署时间预计落在 2026 年内。当时该协议即被称为迄今规模最大的 GPU 融资协议。 截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日，阿波罗管理资产规模约 1.07 万亿美元 （现汇率约合 7.16 万亿元人民币） 。 相关阅读： 《 SpaceX 达成史上最大规模 GPU 融资安排，协议总额约 400 亿美元 》

科技.title: Anthropic 的数论学家声称证明黎曼猜想
科技.summary: 美国数学家 Levent Alpöge 以数论和算术统计方面的工作著称，他目前在 AI 公司 Anthropic 工作。他发表声明，声称与公司 AI 工具 Claude 合作获得了数论经典难题黎曼猜想的一般性证明。他们发现了黎曼猜想的一个证明，而这个证明方法可以进一步证明广义黎曼猜想和扩展黎曼猜想。他称论证过程极其冗长，形式化工作已经完成，但产生的文档难以阅读，他表示正致力于对其进行简化，使其更通俗易懂。
